name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a single dumbbell in one hand beside your thigh.
Bend straight sideways toward the dumbbell, letting it slide smoothly down the outside of your thigh.
Contract your opposite obliques to draw your torso back upright to neutral.
Complete the working side, then switch hands and repeat.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward and your hips level throughout.
Move strictly sideways without leaning forward, twisting, or swinging the weight.
